sehemu: Part V: Court of Appeal of the United Republic
maudhui: A Justice of Appeal shall have no jurisdiction to hear any matter in the High Court or in a Magistrate's Court of any level; provided that where a Judge of the High Court is appointed a Justice of Appeal, that Judge may, after appointment, continue performing his functions in the High Court until completing preparation and delivery of judgment.
